claims.text: A reviewer found that the proposal did not demonstrate EN 13501 fire safety at the proposed bio-content.
Another reviewer asked for a durability comparison with commercial petroleum-based foams over at least 50,000 compression cycles.
Your preliminary foams with 15 % lignin already reached a compression set below 10 %.
You have published how lignin type and content influence the foaming dynamics and properties of flexible polyurethane foams.
Lignin's heterogeneity, poor solubility and limited reactivity hinder high-lignin polyurethane foams, and a eutectic-like polyol platform has been reported to address this.
1731 works since 2021 match 'lignin polyurethane foam flame retardant', so fire performance of lignin foams is a crowded topic and the resubmission must state what is new.

SAMPLE DOCUMENT — fictional, written for Lattice Scout testing. Not authored by any real
person.
Lignin-rich flexible polyurethane foams for
upholstery (proposal, declined)
Summary
We propose to replace up to 30 % of the petroleum polyol in flexible polyurethane foams with kraft
and organosolv lignin. Preliminary foams with 15 % lignin reached a compression set below 10 %.
Aims
1. Formulate flexible foams with 30 % bio-content using fractionated lignin.
2. Relate lignin type and hydroxyl content to foaming dynamics and cell structure.
3. Demonstrate durability under cyclic compression for upholstery use.

Methods
Lignin fractions are characterised by 31P NMR and GPC. Foams are produced in free-rise
conditions and analysed by SEM, compression testing and dynamic mechanical analysis.
Expected outcomes
A formulation window for lignin-rich flexible foams and a dataset linking lignin structure to foam
properties.

Panel summary and reviewer comments
Reviewer 1: The preliminary data are convincing and the team has the right expertise in lignin
chemistry.
Reviewer 2: The applicants do not demonstrate that the foams meet fire-safety standard EN 13501
at the proposed bio-content.
Reviewer 3
Fire-safety compliance (EN 13501) at the proposed bio-content is not shown.
